stem.en: A car moves at a steady velocity of 12 m/s for 5 s. Use the area under its velocity-time graph to find its displacement, in m.

explanation.en: The graph is a flat line at 12 m/s, so the area under it is a rectangle: 12 m/s x 5 s = 60 m.

hints.en: The area under a flat line is a rectangle: height x width.
